style: Title screen key art for Boogle, a cosy multiplayer island game. Image 1 is the approved picture: keep it exactly, the same camera, the same island shape and layout, the striped lighthouse on its hill, the three windmills on the ridge, the cave massif at the right end, the sand beaches and turquoise shallows, the sunset sky, the low sun at the left and its reflection on the deep blue faceted sea. Same rendered light and colour. Add only one thing: a train. Image 2 shows the train to use: a little toy-like steam locomotive with a red cab, a brass boiler and a black funnel, pulling two wooden flatbeds, the rear one loaded with crates, on a timber-sleeper railway. Draw the train larger than true scale so it reads clearly at a glance, with a bright cream plume of round steam puffs rising from the funnel. A single thin railway line loops around the island. Keep the upper third open sky and the bottom fifth open calm sea with nothing in them. No characters. 16:9. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI.

items.prompt: The train crosses a low timber trestle bridge over the turquoise bay at the front centre of the island, from one beach to the next, with its reflection in the shallow water.
